text.en:
MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 468 May 23, 1974
REPEALING PARAGRAPH (e) OF SECTION 184 OF THE NATIONAL INTERNATIONAL REVENUE
CODE, AS AMENDED
WHEREAS, it is the policy of the State to encourage the development of sports not only to promote the
physical fitness program of the Government but also to promote international understanding and camaraderie
thru sports.
WHEREAS, the Philippines has been lately the site of various international competitions in sports, such as
softball, basketball, chess, golf, etc;
WHEREAS, it is noted that while all sporting goods are subject to the 7% sales tax, polo mallets and balls,
golf bags, clubs and balls, chess and checker boards and pieces, remain subject to the prohibitive rate of 70%
WHEREAS, in order to give meaning to the sports development program of the Government, it is necessary to
amend certain portions of the National Internal Revenue Code:
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers in
me vested by the Constitution do hereby decree and order that paragraph (e) of Section 184 of the National
Internal Revenue Code, as further amended by the Presidential Decree No. 69, be, as it is hereby, repealed.
All laws, decrees, rules and regulations contrary to or inconsistent herewith are hereby modified or repealed
accordingly.
This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 23rd day of May, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-four.
